newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS says "buy" LKN.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS says "buy" LKN.

text.p: DBS Investment Research said on Wednesday it was recommending "trading buy" for construction group Lim Kah Ngam (LKN) on the basis of a company visit.
Its earlier recommendation for LKN shares was "hold".
It said the LKN management informed the brokerage house when it visited the company on Tuesday that LKN plans to redevelop its Hotel Equatorial site in Singapore or sell the land.

"This is positive for the company as it will unlock the potential of a piece of prime freehold land that is currently getting small returns as a three-star hotel," DBS Investment said in a research note.
"It will be a windfall for the group whichever option it takes as LKN has limited earnings growth due to a very small landbank," it said.
DBS said if LKN chooses to sell the land, the site could fetch Singapore $122 million based on recent land transactions in the vicinity.
